Dashboard/data/report variants now use available workspace width; Company forms keep1180px, focused reading variant1000px and record drawers900px.
rootCauses.menu: A locally absolute menu inside the isolated hero had no viewport-edge placement and remained in a card stacking context. Replaced with shared native top-layer popover, RTL/LTR anchoring, clamp/flip, keyboard focus, Escape isolation, outside dismissal and native-dialog subtree portal. Baseline desktop probe did not find actual occlusion; no claim of a reproduced Production deployment failure.
rootCauses.expenses: Funding column, repeated payment badges, expanded warning panels, tall source totals, primary correction action and three monetary columns competed for row space. New essential grid uses date, two-line description, type, counterparty, Project, gross, lifecycle and compact actions; full text/funding/net/VAT/blockers stay in details.

ownerDecision.confirmed: Maker historical actual Company expenditures in the imported August–November2026 set were paid by Barq Custody unless specific evidence contradicts that fact. This confirmation is recorded here without asking the owner to reconfirm it.
ownerDecision.activation: After Migration93 approval/activation, use the existing Maker accountant setup to save one audited SOURCE_SET entry per exact existing original file/hash and approved original source-month scope, selecting the verified existing Barq Custodian. ownerDecision.exclusions: Other Companies, unrelated/future transactions, receipts/mixed inflows, explicit conflicting payer evidence, disputed payments and Payroll processing. A future DEFAULT is a suggestion, separate from source-set factual confirmation.

migration.scope: One append-only Company preferences table; configure/read scoped metadata functions; append-source-note function inserting existing audit history. No applied migration/function rewrites or financial-data backfill.

limitations: Full defaults/enrichment require separately authorized Migration93 activation, followed by publication and one scoped accountant configuration per imported file fingerprint.

Future suggestions apply to Expense entry and Expense drafts; other specialized standalone financial modules retain their existing funding selection. Historical Contractor/Employee source workflows reuse confirmed source-set facts.
Enrichment adds audit notes/references to linked general financial sources; it does not add file-upload capability or expand editable posted document fields.

Laptop essential Expense columns fit the workspace. Mobile tables deliberately scroll horizontally; all values/actions remain reachable. Existing server-paged posted lists link to the full Migration92 journal report for complete search/filtering; no page-slice totals/search are presented as global.
Current Maker balances were not freshly queried. Tests and screenshots use isolated synthetic canonical fixtures; no real accounting execution is implied.
